findings.title: Unset effort has no defined SDK mapping
findings.description: Slice 931 defines `AgentConfig.effort` as optional, with unset meaning the backend default. Calling `config.effort.value` unconditionally fails for the default case, including aliases without an effort setting. Specify that an unset value omits the SDK argument, and test a review without configured effort.

findings.title: Turn startup is outside the stated timeout
findings.description: The design says the turn timeout bounds runtime startup, but D7 and the failure table apply it only around `thread.run`. A hang in `AsyncCodex.__aenter__`, initialization, or `thread_start` can therefore block a review indefinitely. Bound those operations and specify cleanup and the resulting error when startup times out.

findings.title: Login and logout lack complete I/O failure handling
findings.description: The login timeout covers only `handle.wait()`. Runtime startup, login initiation, cancellation and logout have no specified handling for hangs or transport disconnects. Define bounded handling, cleanup, and user-visible errors for those paths so the new auth commands cannot hang indefinitely or report an ambiguous outcome.
